🎯 Executive Recommendation: Deploy MediaPipe Pose Lite
Across all 7 exercise types, MediaPipe Pose Lite proved to be the superior on-device model: it is faster than MoveNet Lightning (64.2 FPS vs 56.8 FPS), maintains 98.6% frame validity (zero dropouts on 4 movements), and avoids the severe catastrophic limb collapses MoveNet exhibited during crossed-leg stretches and forward hip hinges.

💡 5. Key Findings & Architecture Recommendations

  • RECOMMENDED
    Deploy MediaPipe Pose Lite for Android / Mobile Client
    Provides the best balance of ultra-fast inference (64+ FPS on CPU, sub-14ms), zero dropouts on routine movements, and tight alignment with the Full reference model (average error only 5.69°).
  • REFERENCE
    Use MediaPipe Pose Full for Clinical / Heavy Analysis
    When 3D depth perception and foreshortening accuracy during complex arm crossing or camera-pointing reaches are critical, MediaPipe Full provides the most robust multi-stage landmark refinement.
  • DO NOT USE
    Avoid MoveNet Lightning for Physiotherapy / Exercise Rep-Counting
    MoveNet Lightning has fatal blind spots: it inverts torso angles in hip-hinges, fails to register rapid knee flexions during jumps, and drops 45% - 53% of frames when limbs cross or reach overhead.
